features.title: Supports your back for better comfort
features.text: The Bayflow sofa is designed with firm lumbar support to reduce back strain, making it the perfect place to relax after a long day or host guests in complete comfort.

features.title: Extra-comfy cushions you’ll love sinking into
features.text: Generous seat and back cushions create a cosy, supportive space that feels just right—whether you’re sitting for long chats or lounging with your favourite book.

features.title: Wide armrests for added relaxation
features.text: The soft, wide armrests give you plenty of space to rest your arms or even hold a cup of coffee, all while adding a sleek, modern look to your living room.

features.title: Strong wooden legs for stability and style
features.text: Built with sturdy wooden legs, this sofa stays stable even with everyday use, while its natural finish blends perfectly with modern interiors.

features.title: Low-maintenance leatherette that looks amazing
features.text: The sleek leatherette finish is easy to clean and adds a touch of elegance to any space, making it ideal for families or busy households.
